calls.title: Growthbook <> Circle Medical - Intro
calls.summary: The discussion revolved around the transition to an Enterprise plan necessitated by the need for a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) to manage protected health information (PHI) and personally identifiable information (PII). Dan Wathne clarified that the annual cost for a BAA is approximately $30,000, which is double the current $14,000 Pro account fee, covering legal liabilities and compliance requirements. Tal Noznisky indicated that the primary concern is regulatory compliance, rather than feature expansion. Key features of the Enterprise upgrade include custom environments, single sign-on (SSO), and enhanced support options, which are vital for security in regulated health tech environments. Migration support through a managed database is also available to ease the transition from Redshift.
calls.keywords: BAA, Growthbook Enterprise, feature flagging, data pipeline migration, healthcare compliance, A/B testing
